name: Exp_Skyscraper_Fix_ColorAML_X2MACandle_MMRec
summary: This EA combines three independent signal sources — Skyscraper (trend filter), ColorAML (adaptive moving average line), and X2MACandle (dual MA crossover candles) — to generate confluence-based trade entries. It integrates a money management recommendation module (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters. Trades are opened only when multiple indicators align in the same direction across different analytical dimensions.
summary_zh: 该EA融合三个独立信号源——Skyscraper（趋势过滤）、ColorAML（自适应移动平均线）和X2MACandle（双MA交叉K线）——产生基于共振的交易入场信号。集成了资金管理推荐模块（MMRec），根据账户净值和风险参数进行动态仓位管理。只有当多个指标在不同分析维度上同向对齐时才会开仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多重指标共振确认，要求Skyscraper趋势方向、ColorAML自适应均线方向和X2MACandle双均线K线信号三者一致才触发交易。入场条件为三个信号同向看多时做多，同向看空时做空，这种多重过滤大幅减少了虚假信号。出场条件依赖反向信号出现或固定止损止盈，具体取决于各指标的参数配置。仓位管理采用MMRec模块，根据账户余额、风险百分比和止损距离动态计算手数，实现风险可控的资金管理。资金管理方面支持固定手数和动态手数两种模式，动态模式下每笔交易的风险金额占账户的比例被严格控制。该策略的核心优势在于多维度信号过滤降低了假突破概率，但同时也意味着在趋势初期可能因等待共振确认而错过部分利润。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-indicator confluence confirmation, requiring alignment of Skyscraper trend direction, ColorAML adaptive moving average direction, and X2MACandle dual-MA crossover candle signals before triggering trades. Entry conditions dictate a long position when all three signals are bullish and a short position when all three are bearish, significantly reducing false signals through multiple filtering layers. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of opposing signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, depending on each indicator's parameter configuration. Position sizing employs the MMRec module which dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance, ensuring risk-controlled money management. The money management system supports both fixed lot and dynamic lot modes, with the dynamic mode strictly controlling the percentage of account equity risked per trade. The core strength of this strategy is that multi-dimensional signal filtering reduces false breakout probability, but it also means potentially missing early trend profits while waiting for confluence confirmation.

parameters.name: MM_Type
parameters.description: 资金管理类型(0=固定手数,1=动态手数)

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points (unused; buy TP follows MA value)

pros: 多指标共振过滤大幅降低虚假信号和假突破交易概率
多时间框架分析提供不同维度的趋势确认增强信号可靠性
MMRec动态仓位管理根据账户风险自动调整手数实现精细化风控
三个指标各自独立计算避免了单一指标失效导致的系统性风险
参数化设计完善便于用户根据不同品种和时间周期灵活调优
pros_en: Multi-indicator confluence filtering significantly reduces false signals and fake breakout trades
Multi-timeframe analysis provides trend confirmation from different dimensions enhancing signal reliability
MMRec dynamic position sizing automatically adjusts lot size based on account risk for refined risk control
Three independently calculated indicators avoid systemic risk from single indicator failure
Well-parameterized design allows flexible optimization for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 三重共振条件过于严格可能错过趋势初期的交易机会导致入场滞后
指标数量增加导致参数过多增加了过度拟合历史数据的风险
默认止损止盈为零存在未设止损直接开仓的资金安全风险
多时间框架数据读取在回测和实盘间可能存在不一致性
策略缺乏自适应机制无法根据市场波动率变化动态调整参数
cons_en: Triple confluence condition is overly strict and may miss early trend trading opportunities causing entry lag
Increased number of indicators leads to too many parameters raising the risk of overfitting historical data
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero posing capital safety risk of opening positions without stop-loss
Multi-timeframe data reading may have inconsistencies between backtesting and live trading
The strategy lacks adaptive mechanisms to dynamically adjust parameters based on market volatility changes
improvements: 增加自适应止损机制根据ATR或波动率动态设置止损止盈而非固定点数或零值
添加新K线检查逻辑避免同一根K线内重复开仓并增加点差过滤防止滑点过大时入场
引入市场状态识别模块在震荡行情中自动暂停交易或降低仓位减少不必要的亏损
improvements_en: Add adaptive stop-loss mechanism using ATR or volatility to dynamically set stop-loss/take-profit instead of fixed points or zero
Add new bar check logic to prevent repeated position opening within the same bar and add spread filter to prevent entry when spread is too wide
Introduce market regime identification module to automatically pause trading or reduce position size during ranging markets to minimize unnecessary losses

risk_points: 默认止损止盈均为零存在无止损开仓的极大风险
缺乏新K线检查可能在同一根K线内重复开仓导致过度交易
多指标参数过多存在过度拟合风险实盘表现可能远差于回测
缺乏点差过滤在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are both zero posing extreme risk of opening positions without stop-loss
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening within the same bar leading to overtrading
Too many indicator parameters create overfitting risk where live performance may significantly underperform backtesting
Lack of spread filter may produce unfavorable entries in high-spread environments

It integrates a money management recommendation module (MMRec) for dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk parameters. Trades are opened only when multiple indicators align in the same direction across different analytical dimensions.
